fact: The Ministry of Health says five health facilities in Mamou and Dalaba districts were digitalised with OpenClinic software, which offers interoperability with the national system (DHIS2), and that paper reporting into the SNIS continues alongside it.

A November 2025 workshop in Conakry, part of the drive to strengthen the SNIS, was told that aggregated data from the REC maternité register piloted in 15 health centres would feed the SNIS, and a ministry official framed the aim as centralising national health information in one system.
